name: browser-use
headline: antigravity-claude-skills for ai automation
short_description: A CLI-based skill management tool that ingests and manages AI agent skills from external sources, making them available as native Antigravity Workflows compatible with both Gemini and Claude frameworks.
author: jswortz

sections.overview:
Antigravity Skills Manager is a Python CLI tool designed to bridge skill ecosystems between the Antigravity (Gemini 3) framework and Claude-based agent frameworks. It allows developers to ingest skills from external sources and register them as native Antigravity Workflows or rules, enabling cross-framework skill reuse. The tool is structured around a src/antigravity_skills package with workflow support stored under .agent/workflows. Developers working with multiple AI agent platforms benefit from a unified way to manage, ingest, and apply skills without rewriting them for each framework.
Ingesting Claude agent skills into an Antigravity Workflow-compatible format
Managing a library of reusable AI agent skills via CLI commands
Bridging skill definitions between Gemini and Claude agent frameworks
Automating skill registration and updates from external skill sources
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/jswortz/antigravity-claude-skills`
